about: 18-year-old finishing high school in Toronto choosing a university.

items.text: Ontario Secondary School Diploma, Grade 12 average 94 percent, Grade 12 calculus 96 percent, Grade 12 physics 91 percent.
Part-time cashier at a grocery store since September 2025, about 12 hours a week, saving for tuition.
Public repository 'course-scraper': a Python script that collects university course listings, 14 stars.
Public repository 'study-buddy': a React app for making flashcards, 3 contributors, last commit in March 2026.
No repositories that use Java, C++ or systems programming.
Second place at a regional high school hackathon in February 2026, building a bus-arrival tracker with a team of three.
Asked ChatGPT how co-op terms are paid and whether first-year students can get placements.
Asked ChatGPT how OSAP student loans work and how much rent costs in Waterloo compared with Hamilton.
Asked ChatGPT whether it is better to live at home for the first year to save money.
Post about playing cello in the school orchestra, caption: 'last concert before exams, going to miss this group'.
Post from a food bank volunteering shift with friends, caption: 'Saturday well spent'.
Headline: high school student interested in computer science and building things people use.
